trends.name: Iran Ceasefire Fragility & Oil Markets
trends.summary: Iran ceasefire is deteriorating with Strait of Hormuz still blocked (capped at 15 vessels/day vs normal 135/day), risking oil supply disruptions. US oil prices surged back above $100/barrel as Iran accuses US/Israel of violations. Lebanon fighting threatens to unravel entire agreement, with no clear US administration leadership on the file.

trends.name: Big Tech AI Capex Race Intensifying
trends.summary: Amazon CEO Jassy aggressively defends $200B AI spend, signaling no pullback despite market skepticism. Meta commits additional $21B to CoreWeave for AI infrastructure costs. Institutional pressure mounting on Tech giants to justify massive AI investments as sector faces temporary valuation reset.

trends.name: SaaS Sector Under Pressure
trends.summary: SaaS has become the most hated sector by investors, surpassing processed food in negative sentiment. Sector faces sustained valuation compression and profit-taking momentum amid broader tech rotation concerns.

trends.name: Inflation Sticky Above Target
trends.summary: Core PCE inflation held sticky at 3% as economy headed into Iran conflict, well above Fed's 2% target. Multiple inflation measures show persistent pressure, with short-term annualized rates rising from recent lows, suggesting rate cuts remain off the table.

trends.name: Fed More Likely to Hike Than Cut
trends.summary: Jeremy Siegel and WisdomTree analysis indicate Fed is more likely to raise rates than cut given sticky inflation and post-war economic uncertainty. Markets reassessing interest rate trajectory as growth slows but price pressures persist.

trends.name: Memory Chip Supercycle & South Korea Play
trends.summary: SanDisk stock up 2,000% YoY with analyst still bullish; Bernstein raised price target on Nanya investment and Kioxia partnership. South Korean semiconductor exposure positioned as most mispriced global market beneficiary of AI-driven memory demand supercycle.

trends.name: Power Sector & AI Infrastructure Buildout
trends.summary: Smart money rotating into power-sector stocks as AI data center expansion creates new frontier for energy demand. Utilities and power generation plays attracting institutional capital ahead of massive AI infrastructure ramp.

trends.name: Trump Trade Deal Momentum Stalls
trends.summary: Only 4 reciprocal trade agreements signed since April 2025 (Argentina, Bangladesh, Indonesia, Ecuador) with 86 remaining targets and none in 90-day pipeline. Trade negotiation pace significantly below initial expectations, limiting near-term trade deal catalysts.

trends.name: GLP-1 Weight Loss Driving Retail Demand
trends.summary: Millions on GLP-1 drugs driving wardrobing refresh cycle at retailers as body composition changes. New consumer trend emerging with significant tailwinds for apparel and retail sectors benefiting from this health-driven buying behavior.

trends.name: Big Tech Valuations Becoming Attractive
trends.summary: Major tech stocks appearing undervalued after recent correction, with investors eyeing entry points amid uncertainty. Institutional positioning suggests pullback created buying opportunity in mega-cap tech names despite macro headwinds.

trends.name: Disney & Corporate Restructuring Wave
trends.summary: Disney plans layoffs of up to 1,000 employees, signaling broader corporate cost-cutting cycle amid economic slowdown. Tech and media sectors entering restructuring phase as growth assumptions reset post-war.

trends.name: Economic Growth Slowdown Pre-War Concern
trends.summary: Economy slowed sharply even before Iran conflict escalated, raising recession concerns. Post-war environment expected to be fundamentally different, with structural headwinds pressuring growth outlook regardless of geopolitical resolution.
